title: VCs will make billions on Anthropic’s IPO, but Amazon is set to make much (much) more
summary: Massive note conversions reveal the true extent of Amazon's ownership in Anthropic.
llm_summary: VCs stand to cash in billions when AI startup Anthropic goes public, but Amazon’s hidden stake will yield an even larger payday. New filings show Amazon has converted a massive amount of convertible notes into equity, giving it a far bigger ownership percentage
